name: interactive-mindmap-editor
description: Create, repair, present, import, and export interactive HTML, Markdown, Markmap, and XMind mind maps. Works on Claude Desktop, Claude Code (CLI), Codex Desktop, and Codex CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Create, present, import, and export HTML/Markdown/Markmap/XMind mind maps.
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex convert text, Markdown, Markmap outlines, articles, and notes into editable standalone HTML mind maps, Markdown or Markmap outlines, or XMind-compatible .xmind files, import Markdown, Markmap, and .xmind files back into plugin JSON, and repair interaction issues such as compact toolbar menus, fullscreen presentation, incremental expand/collapse controls, two-line editing, collapse hit areas, overlap, wrapping, and recursive node operations. The same repository also includes Claude Skill and Claude Code project-memory entry points, and runs on Claude Desktop via zip upload.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my text into an editable HTML mind map or XMind file, or help me improve an existing interactive mind map editor.
